Glance 2026.08.15.1 improves image controls, update checks, and Windows visual integration.

## Highlights

- Use a single smooth image zoom slider with right-click reset and clear active states for image transforms.
- Copy raw EXIF or advanced media metadata as formatted JSON from the corresponding status button.
- Temporarily browse files with the current extension by right-clicking the gallery button.
- Check for updates automatically on a configurable schedule, defer the prompt until preview exit, or skip a specific version.
- Enable Windows acrylic backgrounds and adjust acrylic opacity on supported systems.
- Open the settings window with its first rendered frame ready, avoiding an initial black frame.
